findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "BIGTAC Tacos Français & Grill Authentique" → 3 lines (6 words, 96px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Notre Carte Complète" (pill) above "Choisissez Votre Festin"; "Nous Trouver & Nous Contacter" above "BIGTAC Fès"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "22 Dh", "22", "Dh", "25"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 3 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Notre Carte Complète", "Nous Trouver & Nous Contacter", "Fast-Food Haut de Gamme").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ⚡ 🔥 ★
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 17 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.w-12 → rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.3) 0px 0px 0px 2px, rgb | div.w-36.h-36 → rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.4) 0px 0px 0px 4px, rgb | a.w-full.sm:w-auto → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(234, 88
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 7 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.glass-nav.fixed 1440px | section#popular.py-14.bg-stone-100 1440px | div#stickyFilterBar.sticky.top-20 1248px | div.flex.items-center 1216px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 8 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 9 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "WhatsApp" 2:1 (#ffffff on #25d366)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.9:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 8 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 149px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 1019px of the width empty: "Les Plus Populaires".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
